title: On the weak formulation of Prandtl's minimum drag problem
summary: We study Prandtl's classical problem on minimising the induced drag for a finite wing with fixed span. The induced drag is given by a singular quadratic functional of the circulation, with admissible functions satisfying the prescribed lift and second-moment conditions.
